claims.claim_text: On September 28, KOSPI fell about 2.7%; 545 KOSPI and 886 KOSDAQ stocks rose; 2700–2750 and the 120-day average near 2710 were relevant chart levels.
claims.investor_implication: Do not use the stated decline, breadth or chart levels as verified trading signals.

claims.claim_text: Foreign investors sold roughly KRW 3.6–3.7 trillion of KOSPI shares, including about KRW 1.3 trillion of Samsung Electronics and KRW 1.7 trillion of SK hynix.

numeric_parse.claimed: KOSPI KRW 3.6–3.7tn; Samsung KRW 1.3tn; SK hynix KRW 1.7tn

claims.investor_implication: The claimed concentration of foreign selling cannot yet explain the market move.

claims.claim_text: After 14:00, foreign investors repurchased about KRW 1.1 trillion of KOSPI200 futures, ending about KRW 0.5 trillion net short; this was interpreted as a rebound signal.

numeric_parse.claimed: Repurchase about 1.1tn; closing net sale about 0.5tn, apparently KRW

claims.investor_implication: Do not rely on the alleged futures reversal until its units and time series are checked.

claims.claim_text: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix each fell about 5% on September 28; Samsung had risen for seven preceding sessions. A subsequent rebound is a forecast.

numeric_parse.claimed: Both about -5%; Samsung up seven previous sessions
numeric_parse.observed: E4 headline: SK hynix -5.1%; other figures unavailable

claims.investor_implication: Only SK hynix's approximate decline has limited news-headline corroboration.

claims.claim_text: Micron would report earnings Wednesday morning Korea time, with gross-margin figures or expectations of 84%, 86% and 87–88%.
claims.investor_implication: Do not treat the stated date or margin thresholds as confirmed catalysts.

claims.claim_text: Samsung would announce earnings Thursday morning, with a roughly KRW 4000–4600 dividend, 1.5–2% yield and a possible next-day ex-dividend date.
claims.investor_implication: Do not price in the asserted earnings or dividend timetable.

claims.claim_text: Easing US–China summit concerns and continued US Section 201 protection helped solar shares; Hanwha Solutions rose about 14%, CS Wind about 10%, with foreign and institutional buying of Hanwha.
claims.investor_implication: Neither the policy catalyst nor the reported price and flow moves is established.

claims.claim_text: Ecopro BM completed a capital raise, Canadian plant concerns eased, LFP production was expected, and AI data-centre battery demand could reach 1 TWh.

numeric_parse.claimed: AI data-centre battery demand up to 1 TWh

claims.investor_implication: Treat company milestones and the demand estimate as unconfirmed.

claims.claim_text: Nvidia announced it was considering glass substrates, lifting Chemtronics and related shares.
claims.investor_implication: Do not infer a confirmed Nvidia–Chemtronics commercial relationship.

claims.claim_text: US employment and PCE releases were scheduled for the next day, and their market impact would be limited.
claims.investor_implication: Verify the exact releases and times before using this as an event-risk assumption.

entities.name: 코스피·국내 증시
claims: 급락의 뚜렷한 개별 악재보다는 기술적 저항과 외국인 수급을 원인으로 해석했다.
오후 2시 이후 선물 재매수와 상승 종목 확산을 근거로 다음 거래일 반등 가능성을 제시했으나, 반등 실패 시 추가 하락을 우려했다.
numeric_claims: 코스피 당일 약 2.7% 하락; 2,700·2,720·2,750포인트와 120일 이동평균선 약 2,710포인트를 저항·관찰 수준으로 언급.
외국인 코스피 매도 약 3조6천억~3조7천억원; 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 매도 합계 약 3조원이라는 발언.
장 후반 선물 약 1조1천억원 재매수, 최종 약 5천억원 순매도라는 취지의 발언이나 자막 단위가 달러로 표기됨.
verification_notes: 공개 시장 스냅샷은 조회됐지만 영상 주장을 직접 대조할 수 있는 검증 규칙이 없어 미검증으로 분류했습니다.
